description.en: A speedy hare laughs at a slow tortoise, so they race through the woods. One naps and one keeps going, step by step.
description.vi: Thỏ nhanh nhẹn chê Rùa chậm chạp, thế là hai bạn thi chạy qua khu rừng. Một bạn ngủ quên, một bạn cứ đi, từng bước một.

theme.en: Slow and steady, never give up.
theme.vi: Chậm mà chắc, không bỏ cuộc.

origin: Aesop’s fable, retold in English and Vietnamese.

characters.name: Hare
characters.look: lanky sand-brown hare with very long ears, white tail puff, cheeky grin and a striped orange scarf

characters.name: Tortoise
characters.look: small round tortoise with an olive-green patterned shell, kind sleepy eyes and a tiny green leaf tucked on his shell

characters.name: Squirrel
characters.look: red squirrel with a bushy tail, holding a little orange flag as the race starter

characters.name: woodland friends
characters.look: a hedgehog, a family of ducks and a badger cheering along the path

artDirection.mood: Bright, lively and good-humoured, with a calm finish; energetic but never frantic.
artDirection.setting: Sunny broadleaf woodland with a winding dirt race path, a babbling brook, a gentle hill and a ribbon finish line.
artDirection.light: Clear spring morning sun becoming warm late-afternoon gold.
motifs: winding race path with orange pennant flags
finish line ribbon between two birch trees
big shady oak where Hare naps
dust puffs behind Hare, tiny footprints behind Tortoise
avoid: mocking Hare cruelly at the end

cover.prompt: Tortoise walking steadily along a winding woodland path lined with orange pennants, Hare bounding in the distance, sunny spring woodland

pages.prompt: Hare bouncing in circles on a sunny woodland path, boasting, while Tortoise munches a leaf calmly beside a mossy log
sentences: In a bright green woodland lived a hare who loved to boast about how fast he could run.
Ở một khu rừng xanh tươi, có chú Thỏ rất thích khoe mình chạy nhanh.
“No one is quicker than me!” he said, bouncing in circles.
“Chẳng ai nhanh bằng tớ đâu!” Thỏ vừa nói vừa nhảy vòng quanh.

pages.prompt: Tortoise smiling slowly and offering a race, Hare rolling on the grass laughing with his long ears flopping
sentences: Tortoise smiled slowly. “Shall we have a race?”
Rùa chậm rãi mỉm cười: “Chúng mình thi chạy nhé?”
Hare laughed so hard that both his ears flopped down.
Thỏ cười ngặt nghẽo đến cụp cả hai tai.

pages.prompt: the starting line drawn in the dirt, Squirrel waving an orange flag, woodland animals cheering, Hare zooming off in a puff of dust while Tortoise takes one small step
sentences: Squirrel drew a starting line, and all the woodland animals gathered to watch.
Chị Sóc vạch vạch xuất phát, muôn thú trong rừng kéo đến xem đông vui.
“Ready, set, go!” Hare zoomed away, and Tortoise took one small step.
“Chuẩn bị, bắt đầu!” Thỏ phóng vút đi, còn Rùa bước một bước nhỏ.

pages.prompt: halfway along the path, Hare stretching and yawning under a big shady oak, the path behind him empty
sentences: Halfway along, Hare looked back and could not even see Tortoise.
Đi được nửa đường, Thỏ ngoái lại, chẳng thấy bóng Rùa đâu.
“I have time for a nap,” he yawned, and he lay down under a shady tree.
“Mình thừa thời gian để chợp mắt,” Thỏ ngáp dài rồi nằm xuống dưới bóng cây mát.

pages.prompt: Tortoise crossing a little stepping-stone brook and climbing a gentle sunny hill, tiny footprints behind him, a hedgehog cheering
sentences: Tortoise kept walking, step by step, across the brook and up the hill.
Rùa vẫn cứ đi, từng bước một, qua con suối, lên ngọn đồi.
Even when his legs felt tired, he did not stop.
Dù chân đã mỏi, Rùa vẫn không dừng lại.

pages.prompt: late afternoon gold, Hare racing wide-eyed toward the finish ribbon between two birch trees, Tortoise already breaking the ribbon as animals cheer
sentences: When Hare woke up, the sun was low, and he dashed toward the finish.
Khi Thỏ tỉnh dậy, mặt trời đã xế bóng, chú vội vàng lao về đích.
But Tortoise was already crossing the line as the animals cheered.
Nhưng Rùa đã bước qua vạch đích giữa tiếng reo hò của muôn thú.

pages.prompt: golden evening, Hare with drooping ears shaking Tortoise's hand, then the two walking home together side by side along the path
sentences: Hare’s ears drooped. “You were slow, but you never gave up,” he said.
Thỏ cụp tai: “Cậu chậm thật, nhưng cậu chẳng bao giờ bỏ cuộc.”
Tortoise smiled, and the two friends walked home together, nice and slow.
Rùa mỉm cười, rồi hai bạn cùng nhau thong thả đi về.
